title: Tap or insert a card
why: Step 'Pay with your card' needs you to use the card reader.

steps.text: Look at the reader. It may say "Tap, insert or swipe"
Tap: hold your card flat on the reader until it beeps
Insert: push the chip end in, face up. Leave it in
Wait for "Approved" or "Remove card". Then take your card

tips: Tap didn't work? Try insert instead
